records.admissibility_note: the pre-declared stability rule requires Ma < 0.1; at H=16 and g=2e-4 the analytic centreline speed gives Ma=0.111, so that pair is reported but NOT admitted as a linearity test. The admitted pair is (5e-5, 1e-4), both Ma < 0.1.

amendments.what: runner re-written against the canonical package (tensorlbm.porous, m22754 port)
amendments.why: the m17677 runner lived in the shadow tree TensorLBM/src and its step constant (2500) did not match the delivered artifacts (1200); see AUDIT_m17677 F2/F3.

amendments.what: steps_cap = 4000 with a pre-declared steady criterion (max|u(n)-u(n-200)|/max|u(n)| < 1e-9) instead of the pre-registration's 12000-step fixed count
amendments.why: the criterion fires long before 12000 steps for these channels (diffusive time H^2/(nu*pi^2) ~ 260 steps), so the fixed count only burned wall clock. The criterion itself is the one in predeclared.json; the cap is a stop-loss, and every arm records its own step count and converged flag.
identity of the two layouts is a per-step statement; 1200 steps is already far past steady state for the 24x24 random mask and keeps the whole ladder under 5 minutes on one core.
